statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The service is medically necessary to correlate intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms
The service is medically necessary to assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and G45.9
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
